title: Rust tunnel_auth accept_post lacks Python's _purge_expired: LRU can evict a live entry while expired ones linger (P-R divergence)
description: Codereview finding on aqyw (correctness pass; pre-existing divergence, NOT introduced by the aqyw diff). python/src/lichen/gateway/tunnel_auth.py:479 runs _purge_expired(now) (pops entries with expiry <= now, tunnel_auth.py:416-419) before the replay/capacity checks and LRU trim; rust/lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs accept_post selects its LRU eviction slot among ALL occupied entries with no expiry sweep, so it can evict a live entry while expired ones linger, and later denies (UnauthorizedTunnel) where Python would permit (the same grant re-POSTed or its authorize path). Deny-only divergence: Rust denies where Python permits. Fix: sweep expired entries (drop expired ones) in accept_post before slot selection, mirroring _purge_expired; consider the same sweep in authorize_decapsulation's expiry handling for consistency. Add a unit test: fill entries, let one expire, accept a new claim, assert the expired slot was reclaimed rather than a live one evicted.
